content.title: Meet 'The Bachelorette' Season 22 Cast, The Twenty-Two Men Competing To Woo Taylor Frankie Paul
content.text: The Bachelorette will soon be back with Season 22, and this time at the centre of it all will be The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives star, Taylor Frankie Paul. Twenty-two men will compete for the heart of the 31-year-old on ABC's show. The new season of The Bachelorette airs March 22, 2026, on ABC and streams the next day on Hulu. As we wait for the show's premiere, let's take a look at the men participating. Meet the cast of The Bachelorette Season 22 The show will be graced by 22 singletons aiming to woo over the gorgeous, Taylor Frankie Paul. The first on our list is Aaron, a product manager from Vineyard, Utah. Described as 'husband material' and 'devoted member of the Mormon church', he has travelled around the world and is physically incapable of sleeping past 7 a.m. Next on our list is Newport Beach's self-proclaimed 'California cowboy', Brad. He loves horses, dancing and the beach. He also co-founded an alcoholic seltzer company and is working toward getting his private pilot’s license. Brandon is a single dad of two young kids and a loan officer from Spearfish. A 'mama's boy' at heart, he is also a Chicago Bears fan who said that his favourite movie of all time is The Notebook. The family man also said he "does not do complex card games", whatever that means. Following Brandon is the Nashville-based STEM engineer, Casey. A big Steve Irwin fan who likes "volunteering, 3D printing and hitting the dance floor for some two-stepping." Christopher is an Air Force veteran and a single dad who works as a fitness instructor. He loves psychological thrillers, prefers listening to music on vinyl, and "looks great in a cowboy hat." With three cowboys in the bag, we are next met with Nashville-based singer, Clayton. He enjoys spending time with his dog when he's not writing songs about a woman he hasn't met yet. Another 'mama's boy' in the group, Conrad, is an Eagle Scout with an MBA from Stanford University. He started his own business in the men's fertility sector to help couples have children. Doug is an ocean lifeguard and avid surfer who hopes to start his family soon. He spends his time modelling and playing guitar. Johnnie is known on TikTok for his viral dance moves and is a former pro-baseball player from Massapequa. He'll be taking to the silver screen to compete on The Bachelorette. He played Minor League Baseball for the Wisconsin Timber Rattlers and now describes himself as a "hoarder with the order". Josh described himself as a 'Disney adult' who "attends the Tulip Festival in Utah every year with his grandma." He is a devout Mormon, and has a plus point as Taylor already follows him on Instagram. Continue reading below Kevin is a physical therapist based in Florida who loves to travel, surf and run. Standing tall at 6 feet 8 inches, Lew is a self-proclaimed 'Belieber' who "loves brunchin’ with the boys". Malik is a tech executive who loves everything about Halloween, and he has a playlist for every situation. Marcus, on the other hand, had modelled for brands such as Starz, Under Armour, and the NBA. His favourite food is pancakes, and he "once got attacked by a bird while on a run." Matt is a divorced father of three who is also 6 feet 8 inches tall and used to play professional basketball. He wrote on Instagram Monday: "Tune in March 22 and see what happens when a former Big Ten basketball player trades game plans for roses. Life takes some wild turns, and I’m here for it." Dr Michael Baba is an energetic chiropractic healer who "taught himself how to fire spin." Mike T is a "reformed bad boy" who described himself as "an Aquaphor addict." Richard rides a motorcycle, likes to surf, and hunts for shark teeth when he's not travelling as a photographer. Rod is a veteran who served for 17 years. Now, he has built an online platform for his fitness and nutritional tips. He put as his fun fact that he "admits that it takes him a while to text back." Ronn shared videos of himself jumping rope, doing the dishes and spending time with his family on Instagram on Monday. Shane is a private wealth planner from Atlanta who played football during his college days at Stetson University in Florida, and now "keeps a running note of the best breakfast burritos he’s ever had". It also says that he is a "massive Uno enthusiast." Ternten is also a pro athlete from San Juan Capistrano. He is a three-time Paralympic winner who specialises in the long jump. After his right foot was amputated following a dirt bike crash, he represented the U.S. at the 2016 and 2020 Summer Paralympics. More about The Bachelorette Season 22 The Bachelorette will premiere live on ABC, Hulu + Live TV, ABC.com, and Disney+. The show will air on Hulu the next day. Previous seasons of the show are available to stream on Hulu, Tubi, and Amazon Prime Video. Additionally, selected seasons are also available with ads on services like The Roku Channel or Xumo Play.
